text:
nina_cs: Customer reports promo redeemed but no credits applied. Promo code `WELCOMEBONUS` shows accepted in the checkout modal, front-end returned status accepted and grant_id g_1298, but account balance still 0 and /v1/usage shows no added credits. Account: acct_8f3b9a. Email: claire@example.com. Customer on trial and needs this for a demo tomorrow, flagged as urgent. Screenshot link: https://files.redwood/test/screens/clip.png

alex_dev: Do we have the redemption event id or the raw webhook payload? Also was this auto-apply or manual redemption?

nina_cs: Front-end log snippet: `{"status":"accepted","grant_id":"g_1298","user":"claire@example.com"}`. It was auto-apply after signup. No webhook payload saved on the UI side beyond that.

emily_billing: I saw a short ingestion lag earlier this morning around 14:02 UTC. I'm running a quick lookup against grants/ledger: `SELECT grant_id, state, applied_at FROM grants WHERE grant_id='g_1298';`

jason_ops: Looking at service traces: outbound webhook to ledger-service returned HTTP 502 at 2026-03-12T14:03:22Z, trace-id trace-00ab3. Retry job failed to enqueue due to transient DB connection error. :eyes:

support-bot: Created ticket TKT-5421 and attached customer info + trace-id.

alex_dev: If the webhook never reached ledger, the grant may be stuck in 'accepted' but not 'applied'. We can run the admin apply flow to fast-track this while we fix retries. Command:```
# redwood admin apply grant to account
redwood-admin grants apply --grant g_1298 --account acct_8f3b9a --note "manual-apply-support"
```

jason_ops: I ran the admin command and got:```
POST /internal/grants/apply g_1298 -> 200 OK
{"grant_id":"g_1298","ledger_entry":"led_9932","balance_after":1000}
```
Applied 1000 promo credits to acct_8f3b9a. Also added an audit entry and retried the webhook consumer fix. :white_check_mark:

nina_cs: Updated customer: "Thanks Claire — we applied your welcome credits, you should see 1000 credits in your dashboard now. Let me know if anything else." Customer confirmed they now see the balance. Closing on customer side after confirmation.

emily_billing: I'll follow up and add a ledger alert for webhook failures so we don't miss this next time.

jason_ops: Filed a small patch to the retry queue backoff; will monitor metrics for the next 24h.

nina_cs: Great, thanks everyone. Marking resolved. :tada:
